top_issues: Promised $115.00 vs Secured $60.00: the enforceability split is the most important risk signal but lands as bare numbers; a first-timer must read the 'How to read this' box to learn half the balance is a hub promise (hierarchy/trust).
'Show 1 empty' link is truncated and ambiguous — the reader can't tell what screen it opens (layout).
The explainer card is long and sits between the balance and the Pay/Receive/Swap actions, pushing actions below the fold on short phones (responsive).
fixes: Add a one-line callout directly under Total balance: '$100.00 enforceable now · $115.00 promised by hubs' before the legend.
Rename 'Show 1 empty' to 'Show USDT (0.00)' or 'Manage balances' and expand the chip.
Collapse 'How to read this' behind a tap or move it to a bottom sheet so Pay/Receive/Swap stay above the fold.

top_issues: 'receive up to 0.50' and 'send up to 175.00' are the actionable credit numbers but are the smallest text on the card (data_legibility).
Recent items' tiny colored bars plus small 'open/closed/settled' statuses are hard to scan quickly (data_legibility).
Account card and Recent compete for attention; 'Open account' is a low-contrast ghost button (hierarchy).
fixes: Raise 'send up to / receive up to' to balance weight and color the receive number green.
Make recent-item amount + status larger and give each direction bar a minimum height.
Increase 'Open account' contrast, add a chevron, and shorten to 'Add account'.

top_issues: Full recipient address 0x92c2d7...cb f0 wraps to three lines and pushes the route card down (layout/responsive).
'Up to 175.00 instantly' next to the amount could be read as a balance rather than a spending cap (data_legibility).
Route 'You → H1 → H2' is opaque to first-timers; there's no plain-language 'this goes through a hub' hint on the primary screen (trust/clarity).
fixes: Truncate the address to one line with a copy icon; show the full address on tap.
Label the cap 'MAX from your H1 account' and make the amount the largest element on the card.
Add a one-line subtext under the route: 'Paid via hub H1 → delivered by H2' with a 'why 2 hops?' tooltip.

top_issues: The two route cards look near-identical; the cheaper 0.000050 route isn't visually selected as default despite being highlighted (hierarchy).
Fee 0.000050 vs 0.000075 USDC is six decimals — hard to compare at a glance (data_legibility).
'You send 25.00' on each route card duplicates the amount above (layout).
fixes: Mark the selected route with a check and 'Fastest/Cheapest' label; dim the unused route.
Show fees as '0.00005 (≈$0.00)' and add the difference: 'Saves 0.000025 USDC'.
Drop 'You send 25.00' from route cards; keep only fee + hops.

top_issues: Proof hash 0x663df6f3...c556 is truncated — for a provable receipt the full hash and a copy button matter (trust/data_legibility).
'Verified by your runtime' and 'Frame #36' are internal terms a recipient won't parse (clarity/trust).
The dimmed home screen behind still shows 'Promised $115.00' readable, competing with the receipt (layout).
fixes: Add tap-to-reveal full proof hash with a copy button, labeled 'Transaction proof'.
Rewrite 'Verified by your runtime' as 'Verified by your device' and 'Frame #36 of your wallet'.
Increase the overlay opacity so the background no longer competes with the receipt.

top_issues: Same receipt but the background is the WETH account view; the visible 'H1 owes you +150.00' behind the sheet distracts (layout).
Receipt says PAID 25.00 but the account behind still shows owes-you +150.00 pre-payment — settlement isn't tied to the balance change (trust/data_legibility).
No 'available now' figure on the receipt, so settlement ≠ balance movement is unclear (data_legibility).
fixes: Blur and dim the background header so only the receipt reads.
Add 'New H1 balance: +150.00' or show the updated account so settlement maps to state.
Add a 'Balance updated' chip after the frame commits.

top_issues: QR is readable, but the amount field is a large grey '0.00 ⋅ optional' and the affordance to pre-fill a request is not obvious (hierarchy).
'Prepare incoming account · H1·Testnet' assumes the user knows what an incoming account is (clarity).
No 'request a specific amount' CTA; 'Copy payment link' is the only share path and sits low (layout).
fixes: Add a prominent 'Ask for 25.00 USDC' button above the amount field.
Rename to 'Receive via H1 (Testnet)' and explain 'This account holds what H1 owes you.'
Move 'Copy payment link' next to the QR and keep the share button sticky.

top_issues: 'Anyone with an account route to you can pay this id directly' is dense jargon; 'entity id' is a new concept (clarity).
'Note · optional' placeholder 'What is this for?' is cryptic (data_legibility).
The SHARE section is far below the QR; the copy button can fall below the fold on a long receive sheet (layout/responsive).
fixes: Rewrite 'Your wallet address — anyone can send to this' and add a copy button beside the ID.
Replace placeholder with 'Add a message for the payer (optional)'.
Make 'Copy payment link' sticky at the bottom of the sheet.

top_issues: The collateral tariff paragraph ('Gross receive: 0.039992 WETH before fees. H1 collateral tariff: 0.1 WETH base…') is a wall of text — a swap should show one clean receive number (data_legibility).
'You receive 0.039992' vs the quoted best price: the net isn't stated immediately; lot-rounding 0.000004 buried (data_legibility).
Limit price, hub fee, settlement, lot rounding and route sit in one dense card with small body font on mobile (typography/responsive).
fixes: Summarize as a headline 'You receive ≈ 0.039992 WETH (net of 1 bps fee + 0.000004 rounding)' and move the tariff behind 'Fees & collateral'.
Make the net receive the largest figure; show gross in small text.
Bump card label font to 13px and keep body ≥ 14px for the tariff details.

top_issues: The book is thin: 10 levels per side, max size ~30.6 WETH per level — for a 1 ETH (~2500 USDC) order visible depth may be insufficient, with no depth/total-visible indicator (data_legibility).
Asks are orange rather than the usual red; without a legend this departs from trading convention (color).
'live · relay' implies a relay for book data but gives no latency/connection signal for a trust-sensitive user (trust).
fixes: Add a cumulative-depth or 'Total visible ~X WETH' line and a 'thin book' indicator.
Use standard red for asks or add a legend 'Red = you buy, Green = you sell'.
Add a connection chip 'live · 12 ms' next to relay.

top_issues: The legend (secured/promised/owe/credit room/in flight) is tiny and sits below the action buttons, so users scroll to decode the bars (data_legibility).
'Their credit line to you' vs 'Your credit line to them' is semantically inverted for the reader and is the easiest place to misread risk (clarity).
WETH is tagged 'even' with send up to 0.00 / receive up to 0.07 — the 'even' label is unexplained (data_legibility).
fixes: Move the legend directly above the asset cards, enlarge it, and make each chip tappable for a definition.
Rename to 'They can owe you (their limit)' and 'You can owe them (your limit)' to remove the inversion.
Replace 'even' with '0.00 balance' or a tooltip 'no collateral posted yet'.

top_issues: 'They owe you, uncovered $90.00' + 'Covered by collateral $60.00' is the core risk math, but it appears after 'Frames signed 15' and a dense explanation block (hierarchy).
Bottom nav overlaps the explanatory paragraph and 'Ledger detail' (layout/responsive).
'If you dispute, they answer within 1d' is good but the user's own window isn't stated here (trust).
fixes: Move 'Uncovered / Covered / You owe' to the top of the card as a risk summary with a single total.
Add bottom padding so the fixed nav doesn't cover the last card.
State both windows: 'They answer in 1d · you respond in 1d'.

top_issues: Filter chips overflow: 'Accou…' is cut off — the Settlement/Account chips don't fit the row (responsive/layout).
A floating cursor dot overlaps the 'Account opened' row (polish/layout).
Status colors (settled green, closed grey, open yellow) are clear but 'Swap closed' vs 'Swap placed open' needs a legend (clarity).
fixes: Make the filter row horizontally scrollable and shorten labels (All, Pay, Swap, Settle, Acct).
Remove the cursor artifact so no floating UI element overlaps rows.
Add a legend: green = settled, yellow = in flight, grey = closed.

top_issues: Proof is truncated 0x663df6f3...e8c556 and 'Frames 2 committed entries' is unexplained — this is the exportable proof and it isn't fully copyable here (trust/data_legibility).
'-25.00USDC' has no space between the amount and currency (typography).
The modal repeats To/Via/Frame/Proof that are already inferable from the list item (layout).
fixes: Add 'Copy full proof' and show the complete transaction id with 'Frames: 2 entries (what this means)'.
Insert a space: '-25.00 USDC'.
Trim the sheet to Amount, To, Via, Frame, Proof and drop redundant 'Frames' if not actionable.

top_issues: The three source toggles (On-chain wallet / Reserve / Accounts) are all ON by default with long descriptions — an off switch is dangerously easy to confuse with a feature toggle (clarity/trust).
'Desk' layout option mentions '#K to jump' but isn't applicable on mobile — showing a desktop setting on mobile is odd (responsive/clarity).
The scale slider '1 px = $10' plus Auto/$1..$100 buttons is powerful but a user won't know a good value; the explanation is small (data_legibility).
fixes: Change the three toggles to a 'Money sources' checklist with 'enabled' state and a 'what happens if off' tooltip so toggling isn't accidental.
Hide 'Layout on wide screens' on mobile or move it to a desktop-only section.
Add a live preview 'how your $215 looks at this scale' under the slider.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' sits next to 'Lock' and above the red 'Forget vault' — one destructive and one secret-revealing action in a row risks a mis-tap (trust/layout).
Runtime id and 'Mode embedded' are debug/jargon items shown prominently in Settings (clarity).
The 'AT THIS SCALE' showcase ($100→$100,000) is excellent but the bars fade out and the caption is small (data_legibility).
fixes: Separate destructive actions: put 'Forget vault' in its own confirm-gated section and add a two-step confirm for Reveal.
Move Runtime/Mode/Frame into an 'Advanced' collapsed section.
Make the scale showcase a toggle preview of a real balance with a larger caption.

top_issues: The FROM and TO card grids are visually identical (same three tiles, same amounts) — only the 'FROM'/'TO' label differs, so a user can pick the wrong direction (layout/clarity).
'(◦) Fund you through H1' uses an empty radio glyph on a single option, reading as unselected/disabled (data_legibility).
Amount 'up to 40.00 USDC' refers to the Reserve balance but the Account destination is 150.00 — the cap source isn't obvious (data_legibility).
fixes: Style FROM tiles with a left accent + 'available' label and TO tiles with a 'destination' tag so direction is unambiguous.
Replace the radio with a check or remove it for single-option explainers; use '→ will happen'.
Label the cap 'Max from Reserve: 40.00 USDC' and show 'Account can receive up to 150.00'.

top_issues: Bottom nav overlaps the 'WHAT HAPPENS' explainer; 'Sign & send' is the only real CTA but the card grid takes most of the viewport (responsive/layout).
'What happens' is below the fold on a short screen — the trust explainer is hidden (hierarchy).
fixes: Make 'Sign & send' sticky and reduce 'Add to batch' to a compact 'Add another leg' link.
Pull 'What happens' into a one-line preview with a 'see details' expand.

top_issues: Bottom nav overlaps the ACCOUNTS card, hiding content on scroll (responsive).
Two of five feature cards use the same shield icon (Sovereignty, Ownership) — iconography isn't distinct (consistency).
'Where your money stands' repeats Home's Total/Promised, risking the reader picking the wrong number as 'my money' (clarity).
fixes: Add bottom padding so the nav sits below the last card.
Differentiate icons: Sovereignty = shield, Ownership = key/board.
Label the repeated figure 'Total (same as Home)' and add 'Enforceable now: $100.00' so the two reads reconcile.

top_issues: Bottom nav overlays the FAUCETS section — 'Test money from the network' is cut off, and faucets on a production-looking Assets screen is jarring (responsive/trust).
Token balances are 0.00 with no contextual bar or 'why' — the single-scale metaphor isn't applied to zero balances (data_legibility).
'Depository may pull 0.00' is a great trust signal but is small and only on USDC; the pattern isn't obvious (data_legibility).
fixes: Move faucets behind an 'Advanced/Testnet' toggle or hide them on mainnet.
For zero balances show a faded bar and the note 'nothing to draw on here'.
Add 'Depository can pull' to all assets consistently and enlarge it.

top_issues: Debts copy ('No debts on the Depository. A debt appears when a settlement or dispute closes with more owed than there was collateral.') is long and buried under truncated signer info (clarity).
FAUCETS is cut off under the bottom nav (responsive).
fixes: Reduce the Debt summary to a compact 'Debts: none' chip with a tooltip.
Hide faucets from the main Assets view.

top_issues: Top token cards (USDT) are cut off mid-card at the top of the viewport — layout overflow (layout/responsive).
'Offer to the pool' is greyed out but the reason (amount 0.00) isn't stated inline — a disabled CTA without explanation (trust/clarity).
Interest '100 basis points = 1.00% per term' is clear, but 'per term' vs the selected term chip (1 day) isn't tied visually (data_legibility).
fixes: Add top padding/scroll so the token selector isn't clipped.
When disabled, show 'Enter an amount to lend' under the button.
Put '= 1.00% per 1 day' with the term chip highlighted.

top_issues: Bottom nav overlaps the H1 POOL panel (Available/Borrowed/Active principal) — pool stats are half-hidden (responsive).
Pool numbers are 0.00 with no clarity that the pool is empty (data_legibility).
fixes: Add bottom padding for the pool panel.
If the pool is empty, show 'No active offers yet — the pool fills as others lend.'

top_issues: The board explanation is dense prose for a simple concept (threshold 1 of 1, key rotation) (clarity).
A large empty lower half after 'Nothing to take over' feels unfinished (layout).
'Kind: Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' is cryptic for anyone but a protocol engineer (clarity).
fixes: Replace the paragraph with a three-bullet list: 'You hold 1 of 1 keys · rotate by re-signing · a lost key doesn't lose the entity'.
Add a 'shares / takeovers' empty state with a CTA if nothing.
Shorten Kind to 'Personal (1 of 1)' with a tooltip.

top_issues: 'Enforceable right now $100.00' is the strongest message, but the green box explains it in a multi-line paragraph — lead with the split, then prose (hierarchy).
'Can dispute without asking 1 of 1' and 'Accounts co-signed 1 of 1' are strong but '1 of 1' reads as a count, not a guarantee (data_legibility).
'runtime' and 'in this page·0x9fb8ea...ce44' are product jargon that undercuts a safety message (clarity).
fixes: Make the green/violet bar plus 'Yours now: $100 · Promised: $90' the top row and move the prose below.
Reword to 'You can dispute without permission' and 'All 1 account(s) co-signed'.
Replace 'runtime' with 'your wallet' and show the signer id with a copy action.

top_issues: The ledger detail block ('Inside: 1 account·H1 at frame #15·co-signed·both parties' signatures and dispute proofs, as JSON. Nothing in it lets anyone spend.') is dense and partly redundant with the top screen (clarity).
'Per counterparty H1 · nothing at risk' (green) is reassuring but a single-line summary can hide real exposure if a status changed (trust).
'they answer in 1d, you in 1d' is clear but 'you 1d' could read as your obligation to act, not a window (data_legibility).
fixes: Collapse 'Inside' into a 'View ledger' expandable.
Make the per-counterparty line a tappable row that opens the account with its exposure math.
Reword to 'Dispute window: 1 day each side'.

overall.verdict: A genuinely differentiated, consistent and transparent wallet: the green-violet single-scale bar, per-route fees before payment, provable receipts with frame/proof, and the enforceability-vs-promise split are real strengths. It ships 'strong' but not 'best shipping product' because the copy is jargon-dense (frames, runtime, entity, credit-line inversion), several screens overlap the fixed bottom nav, and hashes/proofs are truncated where exportability matters.
priority_fixes: Cut jargon across all copy and rename internal terms (runtime→your wallet, entity id→wallet address, credit-line wording de-inverted, frame→#36 of your wallet); this touches every persona's comprehension.
Lead with the enforceability split on Home and Sovereignty in one plain line ('$100.00 enforceable now · $115.00 promised by hubs') before the prose, to satisfy Maya, Dmitri, Ravi and Kenji.
Make risk numbers prominent and unambiguous on the Account screen: uncovered/covered/collateral as a top summary, legend above the cards, and both dispute windows stated.
Add scan-to-pay QR on the Pay screen, a one-hand amount keypad, and collapse the route choice for checkout speed, to satisfy Lena and Maya.

Make proof fully exportable: full hash with copy, 'Download evidence bundle' (JSON) from the receipt, and a real cross-network USDT flow with a visible fee, which closes the largest gaps for Ravi, Kenji, Sofia and Fatima.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I got money in and paid $20, but every screen kept saying hub, bilateral, frames, entity id and promised — I never felt sure which number was actually mine.
blockers: Home shows Promised $115 vs Secured $60 with no plain 'this is yours now' line (01-home)
Pay route You→H1→H2 with no 'what's a hub' hint (02-pay)
Receive asks to 'Prepare incoming account' — jargon (04-receive)
Receipt says 'Verified by your runtime' — alarming (03-receipt)

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: Local and remote balance, capacity and collateral are all legible in a few seconds, but the credit-line wording is inverted from what I'd expect and the legend is tiny.
blockers: 'Their credit line to you' vs 'Your credit line to them' is backwards from Lightning mental model (06-account)
Color legend is small and below the buttons (06-account)
'receive up to' / 'send up to' are the smallest text on the card (01-home-bottom)

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: The book, spread, fee and limit price are honest and fair, but the book is thin and the swap buries the net amount under a collateral-tariff paragraph.
blockers: Order book only 10 levels/side, max ~30.6 WETH — no depth or thin-book indicator (05-swap-bottom)
Collateral tariff paragraph is a wall of text; net receive not stated up front (05-swap)
Activity shows 'Swap placed' not fill-by-fill per level (07-activity)

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: I can see exactly what is enforceable now and export CSV, but I need the full proof hash and JSON bundle, and only $100 of $190 being enforceable is a real stop for six figures.
blockers: Proof hash truncated 0x663df6f3...c556 on the receipt (03-receipt, 08-activity-detail)
Only $100 of $190 is 'enforceable now' — 52% — the split is honest but needs collateral guidance (15-sovereignty)
Evidence bundle is a manual 'Save evidence bundle', not a one-click board-ready export (15-sovereignty-bottom)

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: I can send a payment link and the receipt is gorgeous and forwardable, but I want it to say 'invoice' with a due date, and my client will ask what 'runtime' means.
blockers: No true invoice flow — it's 'Copy payment link' + 'Note optional' (04-receive)
Receipt terms 'Frame #36' and 'Verified by your runtime' need client-friendly wording (03-receipt)
No due date or 'please pay' message field

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: Co-signed frames, dispute windows, the enforceability split and 'Depository may pull 0.00' are all here and honest — I just want the dispute flow and evidence bundle automated, not a manual save.
blockers: Evidence bundle is a manual 'Save evidence bundle' button (15-sovereignty-bottom)
Dispute window 'they answer in 1d' shown but no step-by-step dispute flow or what happens if they don't answer (06-account-bottom)
Truncated proof hash on the receipt (03-receipt)

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: Paying is fast and the button is huge, but I have to type or paste an address — where is the scan button, and I don't want to choose between two routes at a checkout.
blockers: No scan-to-pay QR on the Pay screen; QR only exists on Receive (02-pay, 04-receive)
Two-route decision adds a step for checkout speed (02-pay-bottom)
Amount entry keypad isn't shown in the screens — one-hand entry unverified

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: Per-asset exposure, collateral and uncovered numbers are clean, but I need total net exposure across USDC and WETH at a glance, and the real 'Desk' console is only hinted at in settings.
blockers: No aggregate net-exposure rollup across assets (06-account, 06-account-bottom)
Desk layout is referenced in settings but the dense console isn't in these screens (09-settings)
Per-asset credit lines require mental summation to judge the counterparty

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: USDT exists and there's an 'Across networks' tab, but I can't see the actual cross-network USDT transfer or its fee anywhere — that's the whole task.
blockers: No visible USDT chain-to-chain transfer flow with a fee (05-swap, 12-assets)
Swap screen is USDC→WETH on Same network (Testnet→H1) only (05-swap)
USDT is 0.00 and appears only as an empty lane / token list (12-assets, 06-account-bottom)

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: In a minute I understood the green-violet difference between what is truly mine and a hub's promise, and the proof surfaces are real — the only risks are the honest-but-scary '47% promised' on the landing screen and the constant 'runtime/frame' jargon.
blockers: Promised $90 of $190 (47%) is the first thing seen — needs the enforceability framing immediately (01-home)
Recurring 'runtime' and 'frame' branding reads as jargon (15-sovereignty, 09-settings)
Dense explanatory paragraphs undercut a clean elevator story (01-home, 15-sovereignty)
